name: Engineering Portfolio
headline: Engineering software, built from the geometry up.
summary: Engineering Software Developer and CAD/PLM Solution Architect with 22+ years of experience across CAD customization, geometry algorithms, enterprise PLM architecture, systems integration and AI-driven engineering solutions.
philosophy: Effective engineering solutions need architectural thinking and practical implementation experience. I explore ideas, prototype them, validate technical feasibility and turn promising concepts into useful engineering solutions.

careerTimeline.summary: Trained an artificial neural network to predict resultant forces on milling machine geometry, and built an ANN-based geometric junction recognizer classifying 10 junction types from tessellation data.
Built a tire cross-section meshing pipeline integrating CATIA V5 with the CUBIT hexahedral mesher, and the Quick Stiffness Analysis feature inside CATIA V5.
Led a CATIA-integrated geometry comparison tool, built a CRC engine hashing tessellation and PMI data to flag model changes, and a PDM web viewer serving 3D geometry and annotations to the browser.
